Classify medical devices

classifyMedicalDevices.Rd

Uses an ellmer Chat object (e.g., ellmer::chat_google_gemini() or ellmer::chat_ollama()) to screen and classify unique device_name entries:

  • Is a device: Flags whether each item is truly a medical device ("yes" or "no"), excluding non-device products such as creams, pharmaceuticals, and nutritional feeds.

  • Class: Assigns true medical devices to an EU/UK MDR risk class (Class I, Class IIa, Class IIb, Class III) or EU/UK IVDR risk class (IVD (Class A), IVD (Class B), IVD (Class C), IVD (Class D)).

  • Medical speciality: Assigns true medical devices to a clinical speciality (Anesthesiology, Cardiovascular, Chemistry, Dental, Ear, Nose, and Throat (ENT), Gastroenterology and Urology, General and Plastic Surgery, General Hospital, Hematology, Immunology, Neurology, Obstetrical and Gynecological, Ophthalmic, Orthopedic, Pathology, Physical Medicine, Radiology, Toxicology, or Other).

  • Implantable & active status: Flags whether true medical devices are implantable ("yes" or "no") and whether they are active/powered devices ("yes" or "no").

  • Confidence: Reports classification confidence ("high", "medium", or "low") for every evaluated item to support targeted manual review.

Usage

classifyMedicalDevices(
  chat,
  data,
  maxRetries = 3L,
  batchSize = 20L,
  showCost = TRUE
)

Arguments

chat

An ellmer Chat object (such as from ellmer::chat_openai(model = "gpt-4o-mini") or ellmer::chat_ollama(model = "qwen2.5:7b", api_args = list(temperature = 0))).

data

A data.frame or tibble containing a device_name column.

maxRetries

Integer scalar. Maximum number of attempts for any concept before returning NA_character_. Defaults to 3L.

batchSize

Integer scalar. Number of unique device names to classify per LLM request. Defaults to 20L.

showCost

Logical scalar. Whether to track and display cumulative API costs via chat$get_cost() during execution. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

A tibble with the original rows and columns of data, plus:

  • is_medical_device: Character ("yes", "no", or NA_character_).

  • device_class: Character ("Class I", "Class IIa", "Class IIb", "Class III", "IVD (Class A)", "IVD (Class B)", "IVD (Class C)", "IVD (Class D)", or NA_character_ if not a device or failed).

  • medical_speciality: Character (one of the 19 medical specialities, or NA_character_ if not a device or failed).

  • is_implantable: Character ("yes", "no", or NA_character_ if not a device or failed).

  • is_active: Character ("yes", "no", or NA_character_ if not a device or failed).

  • confidence: Character ("high", "medium", "low", or NA_character_ if failed).
